name: JW Marriott Scottsdale Camelback Inn Resort and Spa
insider_take: This legendary desert oasis has been welcoming guests since 1936, transforming from a simple dude ranch into one of Arizona's most prestigious luxury retreats nestled against the dramatic Camelback Mountain.
whats_special: The resort sits on 125 pristine acres with authentic adobe casitas that once hosted Hollywood legends like Clark Gable and Jimmy Stewart. The property features its own private hiking trails leading directly to Camelback Mountain, plus a world-class spa that incorporates ancient Native American healing traditions with modern wellness techniques.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise guided hike up Camelback Mountain - it's exclusive to resort guests and offers unparalleled views of the Valley of the Sun before the desert heat sets in.
dont_miss: The resort's signature dining at BLT Steak overlooks the 18th hole with stunning mountain vistas, and the Spa's outdoor treatment pavilions let you enjoy massages under the desert stars. The property's art collection features over 400 pieces celebrating Arizona's rich cultural heritage.
pros: Historic luxury resort with authentic Southwest charm and architecture
Stunning Camelback Mountain views and desert landscape setting
Award-winning spa and multiple dining venues including fine dining options
Championship golf courses and extensive recreational facilities
cons: Desert location requires transportation to other Scottsdale attractions
